about: Steps a play check of forge guide lint flags that are right as written (docs/GUIDE_FORMAT.md, Validation, play checks): rule, guide id, the quest or item, and why. An entry that covers no step any more is a warning: drop it.

allow.reason: A class guide for a Forsaken paladin in Deathknell, opened beside the Tirisfal guide that hands in The Mindless Ones (364). A character who has not done it is not offered A Difficult Path, and Polestar leaves the accept out for them.
As A Difficult Path: Rediscovering the Light follows The Mindless Ones (364) from the Tirisfal guide; Polestar leaves the accept out for a character without it.

A class guide for a Dwarf shaman off the route, opened beside the Dun Morogh guide, which hands in Dwarven Outfitters (179) before Sten Stoutarm gives the Archaic Rune. A shaman who has not done 179 is not offered it, and Polestar leaves the accept out for them.
